blurb: While it’s chilly outside, join us as we weave through the cozy corners of downtown Minneapolis’ skyways on a delicious food adventure. Stroll through the iconic “Broadway” Theater District, see the Minneapolis skyscraper modeled after the Washington Monument and visit the beloved Statue of Mary Richards tossing her hat. Along the way, you’ll stop at four charming, locally owned eateries – businesses that take pride in tradition, including a beloved favorite dating back to 1932. As you sample each delicious bite, you’ll learn the stories and secrets behind the food, the culture, and the neighborhood, discovering what makes downtown Minneapolis so unique. By the end of the tour, you’ll leave with a flavorful experience of some of the best food finds in the city, all while soaking in downtown history and local culture—warm, comfortable, and knowledgeable.
